_comment: CI-PERF-04-CONTROLLED-PARALLEL-TESTING — the single canonical, machine-readable state of
parallel test execution inside the NSF-R011 Critical Test Gate (both runner variants).
status OFF  : every pull_request, push and schedule run executes the critical filter
SEQUENTIALLY with the exact pre-CI-PERF-04 command line. The repository variable
CI_CRITICAL_TEST_WORKERS is IGNORED while OFF, so flipping a variable can never
status ACTIVE: the worker count comes from CI_CRITICAL_TEST_WORKERS (or default_workers).
Setting ACTIVE is a reviewed change to this file AND needs explicit owner
activation approval recorded in the CI-PERF-04 report.
Evaluation path (allowed while OFF): a manual workflow_dispatch with the input
critical_test_workers set to an allowed value. It never runs on a merge/PR event, records
itself as an evaluation run, and additionally captures JUnit and resource samples.
Anything unreadable, unknown or out of range resolves to SEQUENTIAL (1 worker): sequential
is the known-good gate, so failing toward it can never weaken the gate.
max_workers_basis: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest measured 4 vCPU / 15.98 GB (CI-PERF-03); 4 workers already saturate the CPU (peak 99-100%).

activation.requires: status ACTIVE committed through a reviewed PR, plus explicit owner activation approval
activation.forbidden: activating parallelism by repository variable alone, or as a side effect of an unrelated sprint
